heading: Rewriting the selection model
body: Most of my week is inside the Vellum editor, replacing a selection model that assumed text was one-dimensional. It was not, and has not been since we added tables. This is the third attempt and the first one I believe.

heading: Reading, slowly
body: Working through Bringhurst again, twenty pages at a time, and Ellen Lupton's Thinking with Type beside it. Also a long detour into printing history that started as research for Halftone and has not stopped.

heading: Sixty kilometres of coast path
body: Walking the north Zealand coast in weekend sections, drawing each one in Tiny Atlas afterwards. Four printed and folded so far. The elevation strip is doing a lot of work on the flat bits.

heading: Saying no more often
body: Not taking freelance work this year. I said yes to too much in 2025 and the things I actually cared about were the ones that slipped. The list is shorter now and the writing is finally regular.
